severities.meaning: public site serves wrong money, wrong settlement, or a stale slate as current
severities.action: roll back the deployment immediately; the proof window RESETS to Day 1

severities.meaning: a daily automation chain fails and does not self-recover within one cycle
severities.action: repair and re-run; the window EXTENDS by the number of days without a clean cycle

severities.meaning: a cosmetic or single-route defect with no effect on published numbers

incidentPolicy.resetCondition: any SEV1 resets the window to Day 1; any SEV2 extends it by the affected days
